title: 关税越加越猛：中国出口反加速，2026冲4万亿纪录？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For decades, the made-in-China label was equivalent to this, but in recent years, that shifted to this.
segments.zh: 几十年来，中国制造意味着廉价商品，但近年来已转向高端产品。

segments.en: China has really developed near monopolies in industries that feed into these cutting-edge technologies.
segments.zh: 中国在这些前沿技术相关行业已形成近乎垄断的地位。

segments.en: And for countries competing with China, that dominance has become an economic and political threat.
segments.zh: 对与中国竞争的国家来说，这种主导地位已成为经济和政治上的挑战。

segments.en: Product trade deficits are no longer merely an economic problem, they're a national emergency.
segments.zh: 产品贸易逆差不再只是经济问题，而是国家紧急状态。

segments.en: The EU is said to be planning to head China with further import restrictions early next year.
segments.zh: 据悉欧盟计划明年初进一步限制中国进口。

segments.en: The European Union's trade deficit with China has doubled in the last decade.
segments.zh: 过去十年，欧盟对华贸易逆差翻了一番。

segments.en: But despite the backlash, China's exports are on track to surpass $4 trillion in 2026, an all-time record.
segments.zh: 尽管面临阻力，中国出口有望在2026年突破4万亿美元，创历史纪录。

segments.en: China's current export boom is really unlike anything we've seen in economic history.
segments.zh: 中国当前的出口繁荣在经济史上确实前所未有。

segments.en: Five years ago, for every container that Europe exported to China, China would export about $2.5 back.
segments.zh: 五年前，欧洲每向中国出口一个集装箱，中国就向欧洲出口约2.5美元的货物。

segments.en: That figure today is closer to six.
Tyrefs were supposed to slow down China's export machine, instead it accelerated.
segments.zh: 关税本应放缓中国出口，结果却加速了。

segments.en: So how did that happen and can Europe or the US stop it?
segments.zh: 这是如何发生的？欧美能阻止吗？
